# Cafeteria Seating Policy

Large group bookings in the cafeteria's east wing require a reservation submitted at least
two working days in advance, through the shared calendar rather than by asking a member of
kitchen staff directly. Tables can be pushed together for groups of up to sixteen, and the
booking sheet notes whether a group needs the projector screen for a presentation during
lunch. Unbooked seating remains first-come, first-served throughout the day, and reserved
tables are released back to general seating if the group has not arrived within fifteen
minutes of the booked time, since holding an empty table longer than that measurably crowds
the rest of the room during the busiest part of the lunch period.
